CREATE TABLE subscriptions (
    id            BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id   BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id),
    plan_code     TEXT NOT NULL,
    status        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
    started_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    cancelled_at  TIMESTAMPTZ,
    CONSTRAINT status_valid CHECK (status IN ('active', 'past_due', 'cancelled'))
);

CREATE INDEX idx_subscriptions_customer ON subscriptions (customer_id);

WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT s.plan_code,
           date_trunc('month', i.issued_at) AS month,
           SUM(i.amount_cents) AS revenue_cents
    FROM invoices i
    JOIN subscriptions s ON s.id = i.subscription_id
    GROUP BY s.plan_code, date_trunc('month', i.issued_at)
)
SELECT plan_code,
       month,
       revenue_cents,
       revenue_cents - LAG(revenue_cents) OVER (PARTITION BY plan_code ORDER BY month) AS change
FROM monthly
ORDER BY plan_code, month;

# Leaderboard Service

A small HTTP service that stores game scores and serves weekly rankings.

## Features

- Submit scores per player
- Weekly and all-time leaderboards
- Redis-backed, no schema migrations

## Getting started

1. Clone the repo and run `npm install`.
2. Set `REDIS_URL` in your environment.
3. Start the server with `npm start`.

#### Configuration

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PORT` | `3000` | HTTP port |
| `REDIS_URL` | none | Connection string |

namespace App\Services;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

final class ApiTokenService
{
    public function __construct(private readonly int $ttlMinutes = 60)
    {
    }

    public function issue(int $userId): string
    {
        $token = Str::random(40);
        Cache::put("api_token:{$token}", $userId, now()->addMinutes($this->ttlMinutes));

        return $token;
    }

    public function resolve(string $token): ?int
    {
        return Cache::get("api_token:{$token}");
    }
}

class WebhookDispatcher
  MAX_ATTEMPTS = 4

  def initialize(url)
    @uri = URI(url)
  end

  def deliver(payload)
    attempts = 0
    begin
      attempts += 1
      response = Net::HTTP.post(@uri, payload.to_json, "Content-Type" => "application/json")
      raise "unexpected status #{response.code}" unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
      response
    rescue StandardError
      raise if attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS
      sleep(2**attempts)
      retry
    end
  end
end
